title: Study 3a: checkable tasks (constraints and a code puzzle)

tasks.brief: An eight-line poem about the night shift at a bakery. Make it good enough to read aloud.

checks.say: Every line has exactly 7 words (a word is anything between spaces).
The first letters of the lines spell MIDNIGHT, in order.
The word "flour" appears at least twice.
The last line ends with a question mark.

roles: You write: draft the lines and fix them.
You check: go through the poem against every rule, line by line, counting words and letters, and tell the writer exactly what to fix. You do not edit.

clues.say: The sixth and fifth digits add up to 12.
Exactly 2 of the digits are odd.
The sixth digit is bigger than the third.
The sixth and fourth digits add up to 11.
The sixth and third digits add up to 11.
The second digit is bigger than the sixth.

roles: You solve: write the working and the answer.
You check: go through each step of the working against the clues and tell the solver exactly where it is wrong. You do not edit.
